اعتنقتا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَنَقَتَا (iʕtanaqatā) /iʕ.ta.na.qa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# اُعْتُنِقَتَا (uʕtuniqatā) /uʕ.tu.ni.qa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
